title: fix(app-showcase): scope the command center work queue to in-review tasks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25503

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

On the showcase command center (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/command-center.page.ts`), the bottom panel `cc_queue_g` is titled 待审核列表 · Work Queue and carries the badge 审批中, but its `object-grid` had no filter and listed all 10 seeded tasks, done ones included. The KPI tile `cc_k3` (待复审 Review) above it counts only `status = in_review`.

Both blocks now read one module constant, `IN_REVIEW = [{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'in_review' }]`. The tile passes it to `kpi()` as before, and the grid gets `filter: IN_REVIEW`, so the panel lists the set the tile counts (2 rows on the stock seed).

Landing: the file the claim names. No `packages/spec` edit.

## Which key object-grid reads

`filter`, singular, as a `ViewFilterRule` array:

- **Spec:** `ObjectGridPropsSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (the `filter: z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema, …)` member, line 5055 at base `1ff43b67ea`) is described as "lowered to the wire `$filter`. THE key, singular — not the plural misspelling". `filters` is declared only as an alias of `filter` (`FILTERS_TO_FILTER`), and `defaultFilters` is a retired key.
- **Renderer inputs:** the committed `sdui.manifest.json`, generated from objectui's built tree at the `.objectui-sha` pin `6fb31dc`, lists `filter` (type `array`) among `object-grid`'s inputs. It has no `filters` input.
- **Showcase precedent:** `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/my-work.page.ts` filters its `object-grid` the same way. That page is the one #7750 was about: the plural `filters:` was written there but never read.

The renderer's own read point (objectui `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` reading `schema.filter`) is cited from that page's comment. This session can only read this repository, so I did not open it at the pin myself.

## Pin

`examples/app-showcase/test/command-center-metric-filter.test.ts` gains a `describe` block. It finds `cc_queue_g` and `cc_k3` anywhere in the page as authored, helpers included, and asserts four things:

- the queue's `filter` equals the in_review rule array;
- the queue's `filter` equals the tile's `filter`;
- both blocks read the same `objectName`;
- the whole `cc_queue_g` properties bag passes `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid'].safeParse`.

## Tests (head `15ef279240`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/command-center-metric-filter.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 7 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: Test Files 38 passed (38), Tests 465 passed (465), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the test file (count 1).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` (`os validate`): Validation passed, exit 0.
- **Ablation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the anchor `'due_date'], filter: IN_REVIEW } },` with `'due_date'] } },` (anchor x1 to x0, blob a98af74d6112 to 8af132bc2407).
  - Red: 2 of 7 failed, "scopes the queue to in_review tasks through `filter`" and "carries the same rules as the tile `cc_k3`".
  - Restore: blob == HEAD (a98af74d6112), `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - No build leg: the test imports the page from the package's own `src`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 45 commands at `15ef279240`. 44 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because the worktree built only the showcase's dependency closure, so that one is NOT MEASURED locally and CI's Lint & Repo Gates covers it. `--ran` reconciliation: "45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

## Changeset

None, with `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true`, so nothing in this diff publishes.

## Acceptance notes

- `cc_k3`'s filter is now read through the shared constant rather than written inline. The value it counts is unchanged.
